messages.text: Why was the refund only R$49.00? I expected R$69.00.

The order records **R$49.00** as the amount paid for the wooden watch box, so that is the refundable amount—not the R$69.00 you expected. Refunds are limited to what was paid for the unit. (refund-policy/v2/amount)
